selection_policy: Select a compact, interpretable 8-unit batch centered on the active evidence axis GEN024-M01-adaptive-sog-realspace-latent-tail after generation_023 produced no child that beat parent but identified generation_023/proposal_004 as the best neutral-variance continuation source. Prioritize three low-to-medium-risk exploit probes of SOG decay flexibility, three broader jump variants that test trainable/signed/objective-coupled SOG mechanisms, one backward-simplify diagnostic, and one exact source replicate control for variance calibration. Defer wildcard radial-resolution and pure objective-only changes so generation_024 remains mechanism-centric and attribution-friendly.

selected_proposals.selection_rationale: Primary evidence-axis exploit: replaces the rigid two-sigma LES tail with a bounded three-width real-space SOG bank, directly testing whether adaptive Gaussian decay improves transfer while preserving source fallback.
Lower-risk additive SOG residual companion to proposal_001; keeps the existing proposal_004 LES tail intact while isolating whether SOG flexibility adds signal without destructive replacement.

Normalized fixed-width SOG mixture constrains total tail budget and tests decay-shape redistribution with minimal parameter freedom, useful for separating mechanism benefit from amplitude instability.
Most direct broader SOG mechanism jump: learns bounded positive Gaussian bandwidths from source-near initialization, testing whether fixed LES/SOG widths are the current bottleneck.
Signed SOG amplitude contrast tests a more expressive residual decay family than positive-only tails; selected as a controlled high-risk/high-information jump under a strict total scale cap.
Objective-coupled SOG branch probes whether the long-range mechanism needs slightly stronger energy supervision to affect ISO17 energy/gap, while keeping the architectural intervention bounded.
Backward-simplify diagnostic: collapses the two-sigma LES idea toward one long Gaussian SOG channel, testing whether complexity beyond any smooth latent-charge tail is actually needed.
Exact source replicate control is required to calibrate generation_024 variance before attributing small Q_total, energy, force, or gap deltas to SOG mechanism edits.

selected_mechanism_axes: GEN024-M01 adaptive SOG real-space latent-charge tail
Replacement versus additive residual SOG tail attribution
Normalized fixed-width versus trainable-bandwidth SOG decay
Energy-supervision interaction with SOG long-range branch

omitted_proposals.reason: Wildcard radial-resolution scaling is useful but mechanism-distinct from the active SOG evidence axis; defer to avoid confounding local geometric resolution with long-range-tail attribution in this batch.
Pure energy-weight stabilization is an objective-only wildcard and overlaps with the selected proposal_006 objective-coupled test while lacking a direct SOG mechanism edit.
